We hope those observations can shed light on the characteristics of the encoder and decoder and inspire future research on NMT.

3 Hard for Encoder, Easy for Decoder In general, the encoder and decoder perform dif- ferent functionalities in an NMT model. In this section, we compare the characteristics between the encoder and decoder by analyzing the dif- ﬁculty of the corresponding task they handle in NMT. We investigate the task difﬁculty by com- paring the training effort of the encoder and de- coder from two perspectives: the number of layers and the convergence speed for the encoder and de- coder respectively.
